items.question: Into what locus does the radiance situated in the throat-cavity attain absorption?
premises: A radiance is situated in the throat-cavity.
The brahmarandhra is the locus of absorption.
The radiance goes to absorption in that locus.
items.inference: The radiance located in the throat-cavity attains dissolution in the brahmarandhra.
uncertainties: The feminine subject of gatā is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: The radiance situated in the throat-cavity goes to absorption in the brahmarandhra.
